description: Single source of the Phase 8 SSIM-vs-PDFium acceptance floor. scripts/check-ssim-threshold.sh diffs this file's 'floor' against the base ref on every corpus-job run and fails a LOOSENING diff (floor lowered) unless the commit message carries an 'SSIM-LOOSEN:' justification token; tightening (floor raised) passes freely.
calibrationCommit: The resampling-mode and anti-aliasing release ( mac-arm64 local armed run, PLUMEPDF_REQUIRE_PDFIUM=1, pinned pdfium shim chromium/8009 with the --render-aliased/--render-nosmooth-image verbs): every floor-gated leg re-measured through the shipped path now that ImageResampling/AntiAlias are live. Supersedes the fix-half-only calibrationCommit above.
corpusDescription: Exhaustive as of the resampling-mode and anti-aliasing release: (1) 8 curated simple-page fixtures in RasterOracleTests.CuratedFixture_RasterizeVsPdfium_MeetsCalibratedFloor (classic-xref, three-pages, object-stream, hybrid, linearized-ish, simple-form, symbol-fonts, and -- new -- vector-edges.pdf, the diagonal-stroke/Bezier-fill/clip/text fixture built for the AntiAlias leg) rendered via Pdf.Rasterize and the pinned pdfium shim (chromium/8009) at matched dimensions, luma SSIM after compositing both to opaque RGB24 -- symbol-fonts is additionally gated form-aware with per-region ink assertions in SymbolFontOracleTests, because a mostly-white page clears this floor even when blank. (1b) new: vector-edges.pdf's own dedicated AntiAlias=false leg in RasterOracleTests.VectorEdges_AntiAliasOff_MatchesPdfiumAliased, floor-gated against the pinned shim's --render-aliased verb (FPDF_RENDER_NO_SMOOTHPATH | FPDF_RENDER_NO_SMOOTHTEXT) per measured PDFium behaviour (fills/strokes alias, clip/text stay smooth on both sides). (2) 16 curated image-XObject fixtures in RasterImageOracleTests.CuratedImageFixture_RasterizeVsPdfium_MeetsCalibratedFloor (dct-rgb, dct-cmyk-app14, ccitt-g4-blackis1-{false,true}, flate-gray-8bpc, flate-rgb-8bpc, imagemask-stencil, smask-alpha, qt-namedcs-fills-over-smask, the resampling-fix pair bilevel-downscale-{gray,stencil} — a 1400x1400 1-bit rules/signature/checkerboard panel drawn at 160 pt so the oracle DOWNSCALES it ~3.15x, the only floor-gated legs where the two engines' resample filters (not just their decoders) are compared — jbig2-unknown-length, the HP-MFP unknown-segment-length shape placed 1:1 so the floor compares decodes rather than two resamplers' views of a 1-bit speckle: 1.0000 at 1:1, 0.887 when stretched 160/96x — and, new, four magnify-* fixtures (magnify-bilinear-gray, magnify-bilinear-stencil, magnify-interpolate, magnify-nearest), the only floor-gated legs where PDFium's own bilinear/nearest MAGNIFICATION filter is compared rather than a minify footprint box) plus the fetched pdf.js bitmap-* JBIG2 class leg in JbigBitmapFixture_RasterizeVsPdfium_MeetsCalibratedFloor. (3) JPEG 2000/JPXDecode: jpx-small.pdf and jpx-scan.pdf (RasterImageOracleTests.JpxSmall_PaintsPixels_MatchesPdfium / JpxScan_MatchesPdfium) plus the fetched veraPDF-corpus PDF_A-2b clause 6.2.8.3 pass fixtures t01-pass-a/t01-pass-b (VeraPdf6283_PassFixture_MatchesPdfiumAndPaints) -- every JPX leg also asserts ink-inside-rect, and jpx-scan.pdf additionally carries its own armed-vs-disarmed divergence guard. 30 floor-gated legs total (24 before resampling modes and anti-aliasing by this breakdown, +6 new: the vector-edges.pdf default-AA leg, its AntiAlias=false companion, and the four magnify-* image legs). Two more legs are floor-gated against the SAME calibrated floor but on already-counted fixtures under an alternate pdfium render verb, so are not added to the 30: RasterImageOracleTests.Point_MatchesPdfiumNoSmoothImage re-gates bilevel-downscale-gray.pdf and magnify-bilinear-gray.pdf against --render-nosmooth-image (ImageResamplingMode.Point). MagnifyBilinearGray_MatchesPdfium_AtBothScales gates magnify-bilinear-gray.pdf at pixelWidth 200/250 against its OWN dedicated 0.995 floor, tighter than and independent of this file's 0.90 corpus floor -- not part of measuredMin/measuredMedian below. Every floor-gated Theory/Fact prints a '[SSIM] <fixture> score=' row under --logger 'console;verbosity=detailed', which is how the numbers below are harvested.

perTestFloors.description: Per-fixture floors for oracle legs gated in their own test method rather than by the top-level 'floor'. GOVERNED: the test reads its floor from here (RasterSsim.LoadPerTestFloor), and scripts/check-ssim-threshold.sh diffs every numeric 'floor' here against the base ref exactly like the top-level one — lowering (or deleting) one needs the same 'SSIM-LOOSEN:' commit-message token.

RasterImageOracleTests.MagnifyBilinearGr.note: pixelWidth 200/250; see 'notes' below for the measured last-LSB-rounding root cause.

notes: Measured 2026-09-06 with resampling modes and anti-aliasing merged (30 floor-gated legs, up from 24 -- see corpusDescription's own recount of the pre-existing breakdown; the file's prior notes said '23', which undercounted the t01-pass-a/t01-pass-b pair by one). Simple pages: classic-xref/three-pages/object-stream/hybrid/linearized-ish 0.9873, symbol-fonts 0.9927, simple-form 0.9989, and new vector-edges.pdf (default AntiAlias=true) 0.9962. New AntiAlias=false leg: vector-edges.pdf 0.9952 against --render-aliased (both comfortably inside the calibrated floor; measurement predicted convergence on aliased vector geometry with clip/text staying smooth on both sides, and the two scores being close rather than identical confirms that shape). Curated images: every pre-existing leg UNCHANGED at its resampling-fix-branch value -- 1.0000 except smask-alpha 0.9996 and bilevel-downscale-gray/-stencil 1.0000/0.9999 -- confirming the prediction that no floor-gated leg not already in the magnify regime would move. New magnify-* legs: magnify-bilinear-stencil 1.0000, magnify-nearest 1.0000 (also asserted byte-identical to Box in MagnifyNearest_IsByteIdenticalToBox -- Auto agrees with Box exactly beyond the cut-off), magnify-bilinear-gray 0.9970, magnify-interpolate 0.9968 (both bilinear-magnify legs land just under 0.997, short of the ideal >=0.999 first hoped for -- MEASURED root cause (per-pixel diff of magnify-bilinear-gray.pdf@200 vs the pinned pdfium shim): 11,928/40,000 pixels differ, max absolute difference 1/255, mean 0.298 -- pure last-LSB rounding from this implementation's single-pass 2D `(top*wy0 + bottom*wy1) >> 32` truncation in BilinearSample vs PDFium's own two-pass horizontal-then-vertical 8-bit-intermediate rounding, NOT a half-pixel tap misalignment (which would produce large edge-localised deltas, not a uniform 1-LSB spread); not a PlumePDF defect, since MagnifyBilinearGray_MatchesPdfium_AtBothScales's own dedicated 0.995 floor is the honest, measured acceptance line for that specific claim). JBIG2 class leg (bitmap-symbol-big-segmentid) 1.0000. JPX: jpx-small 1.0000, t01-pass-a/b 0.9979, jpx-scan 0.9486 (UNCHANGED, still the corpus-wide minimum -- the resampler-vs-decoder analysis in the prior calibrationCommit is unaffected by resampling modes since jpx-scan's placement sits in the minify regime, not the new magnify code path). Median 0.9998 (up slightly from 0.9989 now that more near-1.0000 legs are in the set; even leg count so it is the mean of the two middle-ranked scores, 0.9996 and 0.9999); margin over the 0.90 floor unchanged at 0.0486 -- floor unchanged, no SSIM-LOOSEN needed. Additional evidence outside the floor-gated set, recorded for honesty: Point_MatchesPdfiumNoSmoothImage scores bilevel-downscale-gray.pdf 1.0000 and magnify-bilinear-gray.pdf 1.0000 against --render-nosmooth-image; MagnifyBilinearGray_MatchesPdfium_AtBothScales scores 0.9970 at pixelWidth 200 and 0.9967 at pixelWidth 250, both above its own 0.995 floor. Non-gated measurement-only rows from the SSIM sweep, UNCHANGED: the two adversarial-* fixtures score ~0.29 by design (PlumePDF paints nothing + a diagnostic where pdfium paints partial garbage, by design); jpx-smask-broken/jpx-smask-precedence/jpx-smaskindata-2 score 0.8989 -- each paints (asserted in the PositiveFixtureNames Theory) but follows the /SMask-over-/SMaskInData precedence, opaque-on-unresolvable-/SMask, and Typ-2 un-premultiply rulings, where PDFium's own /SMaskInData handling differs; they are deliberately not floor-gated, and jpx-smaskindata-{absent,1} both measure 1.0000. Per this file's own governance, tightening this floor is free; lowering it requires an 'SSIM-LOOSEN:' commit-message justification.
